name: delete-event
description: Deletes (cancels) a Google Calendar event or meeting; attendees are told it was cancelled unless sendUpdates says otherwise, and it cannot be undone. google-calendar__list-events supplies the eventId; calendarId defaults to "primary" and google-calendar__list-calendars supplies others.

eventId.description: Google Calendar event ID supplied by list-events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID supplied by list-calendars. Defaults to primary.

sendUpdates.description: Who receives cancellation notifications. Defaults to all attendees.
